{{Quote|While AT-ATs would be the natural choice as primary combat vehicles for the Salline operation, no one wanted a repeat of the debacle on Ord Torrenze.|Colonel Maximilian Veers, ''Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide''|<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />}}
The '''debacle on Ord Torrenze''' was an early [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] engagement between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Torrenze]] that demonstrated the need for the [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] to provide unit support during [[Assault Armor Division/Legends|armored]] assaults. Sustained Rebel [[Blaster/Legends|blasterfire]] from building [[Window/Legends|windows]] destroyed a single Imperial [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] on Ord Torrenze after the [[Walker/Legends|walker]] and its forward-facing armaments had passed the Rebel position. Drawing upon the lesson of Ord Torrenze, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] later [[Pacification of Salline|quashed]] a Rebel insurgency on the planet [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]] in a near-identical scenario using a force of two AT-ATs and additional ground support.

==The debacle==
{{Quote|Although AT-ATs are built to withstand a certain amount of blaster fire, the vehicle on Ord Torrenze eventually succumbed to the sustained barrage.|Colonel Maximilian Veers, ''Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide''|<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />}}
Early during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],<ref name="Date" /> [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] forces squared off against [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] insurgents on the<ref name="Imperial Handbook" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]<ref name="Atlas Online Companion">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}} &mdash; Based on corresponding data for [[Ord Torrenze system/Legends|Ord Torrenze system]]</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Torrenze]]. A single [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] fell under attack while passing through a dense [[City/Legends|urban center]] en route to destroy a Rebel safehouse. Waiting for the AT-AT's head and four forward-facing [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] to pass their position, Rebels fired upon the walker from building [[Window/Legends|windows]], eventually destroying the vehicle with a sustained barrage of [[Blaster/Legends|blasterfire]]. The resulting loss cost the Empire three [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]], forty [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], five AT-AT crewmembers, and military equipment valued at more than 13 million [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]].<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />

==Aftermath==
[[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Maximilian Veers/Legends|Maximilian Veers]] learned a valuable strategic lesson from the debacle on Ord Torrenze. Subsequently charged with subduing a group of Rebel dissidents in the city of [[Salline/Legends|Salline]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] planet [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], Veers requested a force of two AT-AT walkers to provide direct fire and four smaller [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]] for support. The Salline operation presented Veers with a scenario similar to Ord Torrenze, as Rebels opened fire on his group's [[Hammer 6|lead AT-AT]] from the upper stories of buildings as soon as it passed their positions. However, with the added support of his [[Hammer 8|second AT-AT]] and smaller walkers, Veers successfully eliminated the Rebel threat from Salline.<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />

Veers' mission report on the [[Pacification of Salline]] and its contrasting outcome with regard to Ord Torrenze, entitled "The Importance of Unit Support in [[Assault Armor Division/Legends|Armored]] Assault," was later included in the ''[[Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', a tactical manual compiled in preparation for the completion of the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] and distributed just prior to the Battle of [[Yavin Prime/Legends|Yavin]].<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />

==Behind the scenes==
The debacle on Ord Torrenze was detailed in the [[2014]] ''[[Star Wars: Imperial Handbook: A Commander's Guide]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] as an [[in-universe]] set of tactical procedures and mission reports for all newly ascending Imperial commanders.<ref name="Imperial Handbook" />
